the effect of heat treatments on wear behavior of AISI 5210 bearing steel.

the wear resistance of steel and ceramic counterparts are improved with heat treatment.
heat treatment conditions have a great effect on wear behavior of AISI 5210 bearing steel.
heat treatments have an important effect on wear behavior of AISI 5210 bearing steel samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the wear resistance of the samples increases with increasing the tempering temperature.
, the hardness of samples was increased with the tempering temperature and wear resistance of samples was improved with the increase in hardness.

the heat treated AISI 5210 steel has better performance against the ceramic counterpart than the steel counterpart in dry sliding conditions.
